title: CTML: A Comprehensive Framework for Continuous Testing in Machine Learning Operations
abstract: arXiv:2610.12515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The increasing use of machine learning (ML) systems in production has highlighted some important weaknesses in traditional software testing methods. Unlike regular software, ML systems can fail in specific ways due to their reliance on data, including issues like data drift, concept drift, and performance decline. To address these issues, this paper introduces the Continuous Testing for Machine Learning (CTML) framework. This framework is designed specifically for MLOps environments and offers a thorough, automated solution. It establishes a standardized way to evaluate ML systems across four main areas: data quality, drift detection, model quality, and pipeline validation. The CTML framework consists of a modular setup that includes a Test Registry, Test Runner, Result Store, and Integration Layer. This design ensures it integrates smoothly with existing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and MLOps platforms. W

translated_title: CTML：一个面向机器学习运维中持续测试的综合框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习系统在生产环境中日益广泛的应用，暴露出了传统软件测试方法的一些重要缺陷。与普通软件不同，机器学习系统由于对数据的依赖，可能会以特定方式失败，包括数据漂移、概念漂移和性能下降等问题。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了机器学习持续测试框架。该框架专为MLOps环境设计，提供了一个全面、自动化的解决方案。它建立了一种标准化的评估方法，涵盖四个主要方面：数据质量、漂移检测、模型质量和流水线验证。CTML框架由模块化架构组成，包括测试注册中心、测试运行器、结果存储和集成层。这种设计确保它能与现有的持续集成/持续交付（CI/CD）流水线和MLOps平台无缝集成。
tldr: 提出了专为MLOps环境设计的CTML持续测试框架，通过涵盖数据质量、漂移检测、模型质量和流水线验证四个方面的模块化标准化架构，为机器学习系统提供全面自动化测试，并可无缝集成到现有CI/CD流水线中。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CTML, a comprehensive automated continuous testing framework designed for MLOps environments, which standardizes ML system evaluation across data quality, drift detection, model quality, and pipeline validation through a modular architecture that seamlessly integrates with existing CI/CD pipelines.
